answer.book: Latin controversial treatise in two books by John Rainolds (1596) against Bellarmine's defence of the cult of saints, relics and images: a dedication to the Earl of Essex, a letter to English seminary students, a preface, Liber primus and Liber secundus of nine chapters each, an admonition to the reader, and indexes of scripture passages and of subjects.
